divisions.title: Hosea & Gomer
divisions.summary: God commands Hosea to marry Gomer, an unfaithful woman, enacting Israel's spiritual adultery. Children named Jezreel, Lo-Ruhamah, and Lo-Ammi prophesy judgment, yet restoration follows: 'Not My People' becomes 'My People' again.

divisions.title: Israel's Unfaithfulness
divisions.summary: God brings charges against Israel: no faithfulness, no knowledge of God in the land. Priests fail, prophets stumble, kings conspire. Ephraim mixes with nations like half-baked bread. They sow wind and reap whirlwind.

divisions.title: Judgment on Israel
divisions.theme: The North will reap what it has sown
divisions.summary: The festival joy turns to mourning. Israel's glory flies away like a bird. Altars become ruins, high places overgrown with thorns. They have plowed wickedness and reaped injustice; now the calf of Beth-aven will be carried to Assyria.

divisions.title: God Calls Israel Home
divisions.summary: When Israel was a child, I loved him. God's heart churns: 'How can I give you up, Ephraim?' Judgment remains inevitable, death and Sheol approach, yet the book ends with invitation: 'Return, O Israel.' Those who respond find dew, lily, cedar, olive.
